name: Playgama: Embed Games and Monetize
author: playgama

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
sections.description:
Official Playgama plugin allows you to earn up to 50% from ads & in-game purchases without hosting or coding!

Usage

You can insert the “Playgama: Embed Games and Monetize” in two ways:

  1. Using the Block Editor:

    • Add the “Playgama: Embed Games and Monetize” block in the WordPress block editor.
    • Enter the Widget ID, width, and height in the block settings.

  2. Using a Shortcode:

    • Use the shortcode [playgama_widget widget_id="YOUR_WIDGET_ID" width="width" height="height"] to insert the widget into any post or page.

Getting a Widget ID

If you don’t have a Widget ID, create it in your Playgama partner account.
